# Generated — do not edit here

Every file in `arcade/roderick-tron/` is a copy. The source of truth is the
[`roderick-tron`](https://github.com/magmacrunch-media/roderick-tron) repository, in its
`web/` folder.

Edits made here are **silently destroyed** the next time anyone runs:

```
make sync-roderick-tron
```

which deletes this folder and recopies it. To change the browser game, edit that
repository's `web/` folder, run that target, and commit the result here. The
path is deliberately not spelled out: that repo resolves whether it is checked
out beside this one or grouped under `games/` in a wider tree.

That repository also holds nothing else yet. The browser build is the only
version so far, and the repo exists ahead of the others so that when one
arrives it has somewhere to live rather than being bolted on afterwards.
